# duploai_s3_bucket (Resource)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS S3 bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A versioned, encrypted S3 bucket with public access blocked
resource "duploai_s3_bucket" "data" {
  workspace_id      = "<workspace-id>"
  name              = "my-app-data"
  scope_ids         = ["<scope-id>"]
  resource_group_id = "<resource-group-id>"
  environment_id    = "<environment-id>"
  region            = "us-west-2"

  enable_versioning = true
  encryption_type   = "SseKmsAwsManaged"
  object_ownership  = "BucketOwnerEnforced"

  block_public_access = {
    block_public_acls       = true
    ignore_public_acls      = true
    block_public_policy     = true
    restrict_public_buckets = true
  }

  cors_rules = [
    {
      allowed_methods = ["GET", "HEAD"]
      allowed_origins = ["https://app.example.com"]
      allowed_headers = ["*"]
      max_age_seconds = 3600
    }
  ]

  user_tags = {
    team = "platform"
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
    delete = "20m"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment that owns the resource group.
- `name` (String) Name of the S3 bucket.
- `region` (String) AWS region the bucket is created in (e.g. us-west-2).
- `resource_group_id` (String) ID of the resource group this bucket belongs to.
- `scope_ids` (List of String) Scope IDs that link this bucket to a cloud provider account.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace that owns this S3 bucket.

### Optional

- `block_public_access` (Attributes) S3 Block Public Access settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--block_public_access))
- `bucket_policy` (String) Inline bucket policy as a JSON string.
- `cors_rules` (Attributes List) CORS rules for the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cors_rules))
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enable_object_lock` (Boolean) Enable S3 Object Lock (can only be set at bucket creation).
- `enable_versioning` (Boolean) Enable object versioning on the bucket.
- `encryption_type` (String) Server-side encryption: Sse (S3-managed), SseKmsAwsManaged (AWS-managed KMS), or SseResourceGroupKms (resource-group KMS key).
- `failure_retries` (Number) Number of extra polls to tolerate a transient failure status during provisioning before treating it as terminal. Overrides the resource's default; leave unset to use it.
- `kms_key_id` (String) KMS key ID used when encryption_type is a KMS mode.
- `object_ownership` (String) Object ownership / ACL behavior.
- `policies` (List of String) Names of managed policies to attach to the bucket.
- `provisioner_type` (String) Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.
- `provisioner_version` (String) Optional provisioner version.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_tags` (Map of String) User-defined tags applied to the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `bucket_arn` (String) ARN of the provisioned bucket.
- `bucket_domain_name` (String) Domain name of the provisioned bucket.
- `id` (String) Composite resource identifier (workspace_id/id).
- `status` (String) Current provisioning status.

<a id="nestedatt--block_public_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `block_public_access`

Optional:

- `block_public_acls` (Boolean) Block new public ACLs.
- `block_public_policy` (Boolean) Block public bucket policies.
- `ignore_public_acls` (Boolean) Ignore existing public ACLs.
- `restrict_public_buckets` (Boolean) Restrict access to buckets with public policies.


<a id="nestedatt--cors_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cors_rules`

Optional:

- `allowed_headers` (List of String) Allowed request headers.
- `allowed_methods` (List of String) Allowed HTTP methods (e.g. GET, PUT).
- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Allowed origins.
- `expose_headers` (List of String) Response headers exposed to the browser.
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) Preflight cache duration in seconds.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing S3 bucket resource.
#  - WORKSPACE_ID is the unique identifier of the workspace (e.g. 69b2aa30675718845bfe87a0)
#  - S3_BUCKET_ID is the unique identifier of the S3 bucket (e.g. 6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e)
terraform import duploai_s3_bucket.data WORKSPACE_ID/S3_BUCKET_ID
# Example:
# terraform import duploai_s3_bucket.data 69b2aa30675718845bfe87a0/6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e
```
